summary:
Vanishing Brent - WTI Spread Revives PADD 1 Imports
In 2011, growing U.S. crude production from shale fields started to exceed domestic transportation capacity, resulting in a fall of the U.S. benchmark crude WTI at Cushing vs the international benchmark crude Brent.
